svg.title: Figure 3-SG-01-2. SG-01: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-01-2. SG-01: 28 events (backed 26, by design 1, external 1, unbacked 0); 74 FMEA modes reach SG-01 (in the tree 60, justified 14, tree gaps 0). BE-1.17 (0x1D2 stuck "cruise active" with valid checksum (GAP-01)) → SWF-006: Stale brake, cruise or EPS data used beyond the detection budget; worst cause SWF-006.C1 (An RX check lags only after 5 nominal periods plus one 10 ms safety-task period (0x1D2 about 0.16 s, 0x226 about 0.14 s, 0x260 0.11 s, 0xAA about 0.07 s); the budget is not yet confirmed against an FTTI (HARA OI-004) or against real inter-frame gaps (tools/can_gaps); O 4, D 3, AP H); detection: Per-message 5-period timeout test for every Toyota RX check, in the CI safety suite BE-1.18 (Envelope bypass: ALLOUTPUT/debug mode in a DEBUG build (panda/SConscript:12-20, GAP-25)) → PFM-001: panda firmware released as a DEBUG build, or without LIONDRIVER_REFERENCE; worst cause PFM-001.C1 (The release is built with a bypass of the release defaults: PANDA_DEBUG_BUILD set (build_release.sh then builds the panda without RELEASE=1, with ALLOW_DEBUG) or RELEASE_VARIANT=upstream / an empty LIONDRIVER_REFERENCE, neither of which needs a recorded override. Up to BL-003 panda/SConscript defaulted to DEBUG and no build path set LIONDRIVER_REFERENCE; since BL-005 the root SConstruct and tools/release/release_variant.sh default to the reference build and build_release.sh builds the panda with RELEASE=1; O 5, D 5, AP H); detection: CI job panda reference release build (safety.yaml, WP-W-03 ATC-19): variant selection checks, then RELEASE=1 build and an assertion that every firmware compile carries -DLIONDRIVER_REFERENCE and none -DALLOW_DEBUG. Proven automated check at a later station (CI, not the publication step, and signed with the debug key), so D 5. At run time pandad refuses a car mode on a non-reference panda (TSR-619); INS-17 reads the version string (human check) BE-1.19 (controlsd hang / stale modelV2 used up to ≈3.5 s (GAP-16)) → SFM-006, SFM-037, SWF-040, SWF-043, SWF-033, SWF-072, SWF-078, SWF-080, SWF-081: Lateral command frozen at last value; worst cause SFM-006.C1 (controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite lateralDelay BE-1.20 (Diagnostics masked during big-model fallback (GAP-17; E-06 excluded from reference configuration)) → SWF-043: Lateral and longitudinal commands computed from stale or frozen model and planner outputs; worst cause SWF-043.C2 (selfdrived suppresses commIssue while the big model is loading or settling (selfdrived.py:391-393), so held modelV2 got no reaction for that window at BL-004. Since #51 the controlsd freshness gate stops lateral actuation on a modelV2 more than 0.5 s old whatever selfdrived suppresses; the alert is still masked (TSR-603); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: test_onroad TestChestnutOnroad needs device hardware; not run BE-1.21 (SoC replays an old command buffer (no sequence counter, GAP-10)) → SWF-023: Stale or burst-replayed sendcan frames forwarded to the panda; worst cause SWF-023.C1 (The age gate is 1 s (pandad.cc:78-79). That exceeds the 0.9 s preliminary SG-001 FTTI and is 100 control periods long. The sendcan subscriber is a non-conflated FIFO (pandad.cc:64; services.py sendcan MEDIUM queue), so a backlog of up to 1 s is forwarded in order but back-to-back. No newest-only policy applies per address (WP-W-04 SWF-47, SWSR-411); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.22 (Command freshness not supervised: heartbeat shows pandad liveness only; mismatch 3 s, loss 5 s (main.c:182-213; GAP-06, GAP-10) . 2026-10-12, reference build: heartbeat loss revokes at 0.3 s (TSR-407); actuation-frame arrival supervised (TSR-408, opendbc 273f44e); value freshness (TSR-409) open) → SWF-014, SWF-020, SWF-018, DFM-014: Controls withdrawn later than the FTTI after host loss; worst cause SWF-020.C1 (engaged is derived only from selfdriveState alive (<0.1 s), valid and enabled (pandad.cc:424). Neither carControl/sendcan freshness nor the forwarding thread's progress goes into the heartbeat, which is sent from the main thread (pandad.cc:313), so the heartbeat shows pandad and selfdrived liveness only (host side of SWF-014.C2; TSR-409 / TSR-602 not implemented); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.23 (Rate and RT limits accept a constant in-limit value (by design)): No FMEA row needed: by design; The rate and real-time checks bound change, not age; a constant in-limit value passes them (G1.3.2). BE-4.19 ((relay stays released; as SG-04)) → DFM-011, SFM-034: Intercept switch stays in pass-through when driven; worst cause SFM-034.C1 (Switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, its IN input damaged high or driven high, its pull-down R2/R3 open, or the switches damaged by box supply transients (DG419LE, RR-2026-010); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: As rated in the DFMEA: no pre-release test of this hardware fault BE-1.26 (Stock 0x2E4 forwarded from the camera side while the item transmits (check_relay entry or forwarding hook defect)) → SWF-010: Stock camera steering or ACC messages forwarded while the item transmits; worst cause SWF-010.C1 (check_relay flag missing for a replaced message in the TX table, or defect in safety_fwd_hook; O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-4.21 ((relay malfunction detected after 1–2 s, not at all, or cleared by a mode change; as SG-04)) → SWF-012, SWF-090: Relay malfunction not detected; worst cause SWF-012.C1 (Defect in stock_ecu_check, or a replaced message without check_relay; detection starts 1 s after a mode change (safety.h:372-380); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements
